findings.text: A minion that was stopped or errored is drawn as still running. In public/framework/ext/AITask/tree.js:410-413 an inbox-only leaf counts as landed only if its last row is `done`, so a `stopped` or `error` row leaves it "running" forever, and tree.test.mjs:564 asserts exactly that (`ghost` → running). "What's in flight" is the core of the ask, so a stopped task needs its own state, or at least must not count as running.

`after` is written in two different shapes. Servex/agents/Agents.js (open_task) makes `parent_task` repo-relative but writes `after` verbatim; the sub-mastermind SKILL.md line says "sibling slugs", while doc/nested.md shows full dirs. The tree tolerates both through suffix matching (tree.js:431, 452), but a slug like `data` also matches any sibling whose dir merely ends in `/data`. Pick one form (dirs, normalized like parent_task) and say it the same way in the skill, tools.js and the doc.

"Each spawned mastermind session is automatically a task" is only half done. A task is opened only when the caller passes `task:` to spawn_agent (Agents.js:99), and `parent_task` defaults to the parent's live `task.dir`. So a mastermind started from a tab, or any spawn without `task`, still has no line 1, and its minions are placed only by folder or inbox guesses.

The Demo page and the Lanes page are the same page: both draw plan.js with `Winner` = Lanes (tree/demo/page.js, tree/lanes/page.js). The switcher also lists "The winner, on today's tasks" beside "Lanes (the default)", which reads as two different things. Simpler: make the demo page the Lanes page, list only the three designs, and name the live link "Today's tasks".

AITask.route() (AITask.js:119) makes a synchronous XHR for the whole /framework/directory.json on any child route with no dot in it, which blocks the page while that file downloads. It is cached for 10 s, but a big ai/ tree makes every first click stall. Worth checking the file's size, or skipping the lookup when Page.child() would already resolve the route.

Screenshot 127-0-0-1-52847-framework-ext-AITask-tree/sheet.png: the real day shows "3 running · 0 waiting · 13 landed", so waiting and series never appear on real data yet, because no log carries `after` so far. The owner's test ("which waited") can only be passed on the demo today; say so on the tree page or in the report.

Same sheet: running roots are titled by folder slug (`minion-a-routes`, `readme-chain`), while landed ones have real titles. tree.js:376 falls back to the dir name; the log's card or brief title would read better. The landed roots are each a full-width row, so at 1280 the one screen is mostly finished work, below two small running cards.

127-0-0-1-52847-framework-ext-AITask-tree-demo/sheet.png at 3440: the phase-1 lane stretches to about 1500px, while "Read today's logs" is one short line, and the "then" arrow is tiny and grey. It is the single cue for series, so it should be bolder. At 1280 and 1920 the Lanes layout reads well: parallel side by side, and the nested minions of "Build the tree" are clear.

127-0-0-1-52847-framework-ext-AITask-tree-flow/sheet.png: the graph stays about 900px wide at every width, and the "waits for …" text in the phase-2 nodes is ellipsized. Also nested.js:199 hardcodes `56` where it should use `GX`.

The AITask overview (127-0-0-1-52847-framework-ext-AITask/sheet.png) gains a "Task tree" tab, which is good. But the tree pages each show a stray "Folder" chip under the title, and the intro sentence and the designs row sit above the tree in small grey text. Counts plus the tree could come first.

leaf % is `(step-1)/steps` (tree.js:368), not step/steps as the brief wrote. The doc explains why (finished steps), which is reasonable, but it is a deliberate change from the owner's rule and should be named as one in the report.
